intro: Two homes and a locus that could be placed on either. Every bar here is a picture; R7.2.1D stage 2 has not run.

steps.caption: L is placed on home A because A had the fewest loci — fairness among runnable carriers.
But what L needs to make progress — its mailbox, its authority working set — is resident on B. On A it spends its commands relocating.
steps.takeaway: Placement by fairness optimizes the carriers' view; placement by progress optimizes the loci's.

steps.caption: Re-place L where its semantic progress is greatest.
The picture says progress goes up. The battery that would say by how much — placement on the compiled home, R7.2.1D stage 2 — is prespecified and unrun.
steps.takeaway: Do not write the number before the battery: this page carries no measurement, and the bars are not one.

steps.caption: The oracle for that battery already exists and has a red control of its own (metrics_mutant=); the comparator was built before the thing it compares.
steps.takeaway: A comparator without a red control cannot be trusted to have looked.
